text: 1) Scanned copy of the first page of passport (valid later than September 2025); 2) Notarized certificate of the highest degree. If the applicant is a current student, they must provide the pre-graduation certificate issued by their school. Notarized Chinese or English translation shall be attached to any text other than Chinese and English. 3) Academic transcipts. Applicants for bachelor degree must submit scanned copy of their high school transcipt; applicants for master’s degree must submit scanned copy of study transcript. Transcipts in languages other than Chinese or English, must be accompanied by a notarized Chinese or English translation. 4) Scanned copies of Chinese and English proficiency 3 certificates; Note: Applicants who intend to study in Chinese must submit an HSK level 5 certificate. Those who have already completed a degree taught in Chinese are exempt from this requirement. Applicants who intend to study in English must provide an IELTS score of 6.0 or equivalent, or a TOEFL score of 85 or equivalent. Applicants from English-speaking countries or those whose previous degree program was taught in English are exempt from providing proof of English language proficiency. 5) Recommendation letters. Applicants for master’s degree must submit letters of recommendation from 2 associate professors or above; 6) Study plan (more than 1000 words, written in Chinese or English); 7) Physical examination records for foreigners (refer to Appendix 1, the template must be filled in English and the examination results are valid for 6 months); 8) Proof of no criminal record (supporting documents within 6 months before the application date).
